#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Deployment paths
WORK_DIR="/tmp/git-deploy"
MAIN_DEPLOY="/var/www/main"
DEV_DEPLOY="/var/www/dev"
REPO="/git/project.git"

# Function to deploy a branch
deploy_branch() {
    local branch=$1
    local deploy_path=$2

    # Create work directory
    rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"

    # Clone the specific branch
    cd "$WORK_DIR"
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "$branch" "$REPO" .

    # Check if index.html exists and copy it
    if [ -f "index.html" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$deploy_path"
        cp index.html "$deploy_path/index.html"
        echo "Deployed $branch to $deploy_path"
    else
        echo "Warning: index.html not found in $branch"
    fi
}

# Read input and process each ref
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    # Extract branch name from refname (refs/heads/main -> main)
    branch="${refname##refs/heads/}"

    if [ "$refname" = "refs/heads/main" ]; then
        deploy_branch "main" "$MAIN_DEPLOY"
    elif [ "$refname" = "refs/heads/dev" ]; then
        deploy_branch "dev" "$DEV_DEPLOY"
    fi
done

# Cleanup
rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
